title: Sonora Tour Day 3 (Mother's Day): Pensión Mujeres Bienestar Delivery in Ciudad Obregón; Tour Concludes
detail: On May 10, 2026 — Mother's Day in Mexico — President Claudia Sheinbaum concluded her three-day Sonora working tour (her fifth state visit since taking office) with an event in Ciudad Obregón, the commercial capital of the Cajeme municipality. At 10:30 AM, Sheinbaum led a Pensión Mujeres Bienestar delivery event for women aged 60–64, a social program that provides bimonthly cash transfers of 3,100 pesos. The event included a small concert in celebration of Mother's Day in Sonora. The tour was accompanied by Cajeme mayor Javier Lamarque Cano. Sheinbaum departed for Mexico City around 4:00 PM to celebrate Mother's Day with her own mother, Dr. Annie Pardo Cemo — a biochemist and cell biology researcher whose career inspired Sheinbaum's own scientific path. No mañanera was held on May 10 (Sunday and national holiday). The three-day Sonora tour (May 8–10) delivered: the Seri Aqueduct at Punta Chueca (Day 1); Hospital General de Zona No. 15 inauguration in Hermosillo, Yaqui Land Restitution Decree in San Ignacio Río Muerto, and Navojoa Main Canal delivery (Day 2); and the Bienestar Mother's Day event in Ciudad Obregón (Day 3). The backdrop of ongoing sovereignty tensions — Trump consulate review, CIA-Chihuahua probe at FGR, DOJ indictment of Sinaloa Governor Rocha Moya — continued as the first formal USMCA negotiating round remained on track for the week of May 25.

media.caption: Sheinbaum closes three-day Sonora tour with Pensión Mujeres Bienestar delivery in Ciudad Obregón on Mother's Day; departs for Mexico City to visit her own mother
